items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Progress/current: Save 01 single player, autosave. Task sheet VERIFIED crossed out get into garden, get groundskeeper wet, picnic apple and basket. Sandwich was visibly left on blanket earlier but NOT credited on later task sheet; may need repositioning (guess). Keys, sun hat, rake-in-lake and full picnic unfinished. No additional deliveries confirmed. Latest observed goose empty-beaked, neck lowered, beside yellow carrot crate with beak at crate corner; exposed leafy carrot left in soil, groundskeeper above-left. Last executed action: stationary left drag (0.418,0.887), 0.6s toward exposed carrot; resulting position not observed. Current goal collecting carrot near exit; broader goal complete garden tasks/picnic. Repeated item losses need investigation, not automatically attributed to interception.
Controls: Hold left mouse toward cursor to walk; stationary drag same normalized start/end for 0.5–2s generally moves, but many approaches overshoot/change facing or appear inconsistent. Camera follows and changes coordinates substantially. Use fresh positions, ground beneath elevated items, short approaches; walk around obstructions. Single left-click did not visibly reach rake. Relative dx/dy control movements often poor/unpredictable. Right-click grabs/releases nearby item based on proximity/facing, NOT reliably clicked target (bags instead of radio, spare sandwich instead of apple). Pointer-only aiming sometimes preceded facing changes but latest carrot test explicitly did NOT turn goose; not reliable. White marks/outline useful for reach but may belong to neighbor (crate/cooler handle instead of food). Z is alternate beak: holding 1s successfully grabbed rake, jar and carrots when aligned; brief Z and many right-clicks failed on rake. Sustained Z is not guaranteed without alignment. Some carried items persisted across ordinary drags, others disappeared; latest hypothesis that Z may need remaining held during travel is UNRESOLVED. A Z+left movement attempt did not establish this. Do not assume retrieval unless seen.
Bend Options changed from HOLD to visibly confirmed TOGGLE. Control_L 0.1s toggles neck with delayed visual confirmation. Last deliberate toggle lowered neck for carrots; latest observations lowered. Raised neck helped reach tabletop jar; lowered helped ground carrots/rake/basket. Posture sometimes varied without deliberate toggle; bulky dragging can lower neck. Space honk. Tab task sheet, 0.1s then observe/wait; now CLOSED. Inputs commonly show delayed effects, separate ~1s wait useful; execution completed alone proves no game result. A held 1s visibly zoomed out (confirmed). S zoom in listed but untested. Shift run listed, tried Shift_L+left with relative dx/dy during carrot escapes; movement occurred, no successful delivery or clear speed verification. Tutorial double-click run. X wings listed, sometimes spread spontaneously during keeper encounters; cause uncertain. Run/wings/zoom options remain HOLD.
Map: Opening wooded fork -> upper-right rocky trail -> low fallen trunk/stream -> boot/bicycle -> stump fork; right trail to starting wooden gate, then plants/water by stone wall. Swam across to bench bank. Left branch at stump unexplored. Bench blue cloth, initially two sandwich pieces and apple, basket beside it. Paved path behind bench, water in front. Shoreline right -> drinking fountain -> red/blue picnic blanket down-right beside hedge. Blanket up along hedge/narrow gray path -> wider fountain walkway -> opposite grass/red mower beside garden wall. Follow wall left/up-left to garden gateway with noticeboard on right. Open gate swings outward and blocks direct route: go below free end, right to paving stones, up through gap by noticeboard; reverse to exit. Outside left of gate are displaced bags/shovel and last confirmed original radio area. Hose follows outside wall left/up-left to red tap. Inside gateway carrot bed ahead/above, crate near carrots; stepping stones below carrots lead down to gateway. Wall/hose strip left of carrots leads to dry sprinkler/soil mound. Pumpkins above-left of mound, flower beds farther right; cabbage/large leafy bed nearby. Grass corridors between pumpkin/flower beds lead upward to watering can and paving by large water tank, then right toward table/chair/shed. Wheelbarrow below table area; avoid handles. Table holds checked-lid jar (jam-like picnic item) and green thermos. Orange cooler nearby has small gray radio-like object, identity unconfirmed (could be original radio moved; no evidence of two radios). Cooler handle can show interaction marks. Yellow sun hat hangs on shed door. Rake resting against hedge beside shed, to right of hat near terracotta pot/boots and another closed wooden door/gate. Pot, chair, watering can, beds and gate panel obstruct approaches.
Wet task SUCCESS: red handle on gray pipe is OUTSIDE low brick wall; inside approach never activated water. Exit gateway, clear gate panel, follow exterior wall left/up-left past bags to tap. Standing directly beneath handle and right-clicking activated sprinkler inside soil bed; white marks showed reach. Honked and waited 2s: groundskeeper approached outside tap. Keys visible, right-click attempt did not confirm theft; sprinkler subsequently off (cause not directly established). Reapproached directly beneath tap and right-clicked again: spray on, green boot partly visible at top edge. Tab then confirmed wet task complete. Later sprinkler repeatedly off; latest dry. No need to repeat wet goal.
Picnic state: Apple and basket credited. Sandwich visibly released on cloth with wait earlier but later sheet left sandwich uncrossed. Spare sandwich dropped on shoreline grass in front of bench. Basket required lowered neck, verified dragged to blanket, released and remained after walking around right side. Bench legs block direct rightward travel: move down toward shore then right. Blanket basket also obstructed path. Remaining uncredited picnic: sandwich, pumpkin, carrot, jam, thermos, radio. No post-loss picnic credit check beyond apple/basket.
Radio history: outside left gate on bags initially. Upright grab took bag, pulling it
